addedCalculatedDilutedEps.dilutionBasis: Given the net loss, adding back positive interest expense on convertibles or increasing the outstanding share denominator reduces the loss per share. Both types of potential common shares are antidilutive. The issuer applies this same treatment to its loss periods.
addedCalculatedDilutedEps.method: Subtract the first nine months from the full-year attributable basic loss. Subtract nine-month share-days from full-year share-days and divide the difference by the days in the fourth quarter. Use basic shares because all potential shares are antidilutive in the loss period.

Subtract the first three quarters using that weighting.

ATO.finding: The issuer marks the FY2026 fourth-quarter financial statement unavailable. Its earnings slides confirm the quarter’s EPS and do not supply consolidated operating revenue. Await the FY2026 10-K or a consolidated fourth-quarter statement.

BRK-B.finding: Class A converts at 1,500 Class B shares per A share, the same ratio used for Class B-equivalent earnings and distributions. The proxy describes a policy against paying employees in Berkshire stock. These support why the published basic amount could be economically equivalent to a diluted amount. Berkshire tags only basic EPS in the five reviewed periods. SEC guidance calls for both tags when an issuer presents one amount as both basic and diluted. Retain the confirmed basic disclosures and the unverified diluted fields.

TXT.finding: Even if the comparative nine-month consolidated EPS is used to tighten the back-calculation, two rounding outcomes remain possible. The exact quarterly continuing-operations figure is separately disclosed.

TRGP.finding: The issuer’s Q4 earnings supplement gives no diluted EPS. The Q4 press release supplies net income but does not disclose the quarter’s two-class earnings allocation or diluted share count.

AES.finding: The investor page’s Q4 2025 release link opens the general newsroom. The acquisition notice explicitly canceled the scheduled earnings call and pointed investors to the annual filing. No standalone results date was established in that IR review.

ECHO.finding: The issuer results page lists 2026 Q2 and Q1 releases. SEC has the Q3 10-Q and a separate governance 8-K. No Q3 results release was established.
